newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource to offer $125 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource to offer $125 mln debt.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc said on Thursday that it intends to make a private offering of $125 million of convertible subordinated debentures due 2001.
The debentures will be convertible into Physicians Resource common stock and will be subordinated to the company's senior debts, the company said.
Proceeds are expected to be used to repay bank debt in connection with acquistions and for general corporate purposes, including funding of potential future acquisitions, Physicians Resource said.
